title: How to Kill Useless Credit Card Protection Fees
hook_text: CHECK YOUR CREDIT CARD STATEMENT NOW

beats.say: Check your credit card statement today for a fee called protection you never asked for.
beats.visual: Close up of hands holding a dark credit card on rain-slicked wet asphalt at night under sodium light.

beats.say: Millions of cardholders pay $10 to $20 every single month for credit monitoring or payment insurance.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person standing at a cold fluorescent payphone terminal in a fog-covered alleyway.

beats.say: Why are financial institutions quietly adding these features, and where does that cash actually go?
beats.visual: Low angle view of a massive glass skyscraper looming in dark misty blue hour light.

beats.say: You'd think it safeguards your credit score, but it mostly protects the bank's own balance sheet.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a lone car parked under a single flickering streetlight on an empty highway.

beats.say: So how much money are you quietly leaking over time without ever realizing it?
beats.visual: High angle shot of a solitary figure walking past tall brutalist concrete pillars under dim sodium lighting.

beats.say: A simple $15 monthly fee adds up to $1,800 stolen from your pocket over 10 years.
beats.visual: Extreme close up of a hand holding a brass key near cold metallic safety deposit boxes.

beats.say: Here's how you kill this useless fee today in less than 3 minutes.
beats.visual: Silhouette standing at the edge of an empty wet parking deck overlooking a misty city skyline.

beats.say: Step one. Log into your credit card app and click on account services or statement details.
beats.visual: Hands holding a dark sleek mobile phone from behind in a dark room lit by cold blue light.

beats.say: Step two. Search for payment protection, add-on products, or credit alert services under enrolled benefits.
beats.visual: Extreme low angle shot of an empty concrete subway platform late at night in heavy fog.

beats.say: Step three. Click cancel, or open live chat and type, opt me out of all add-on plans immediately.
beats.visual: A lone figure standing inside a misty glass elevator ascending a dark building exterior.

beats.say: That's a simple 3-minute opt-out that stops the hidden leak and puts $1,800 back where it belongs.
beats.visual: High angle shot of wet city asphalt reflecting gold lights in the deep blue dusk.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you, and check your statement every single month.
beats.visual: Wide silhouette of a person standing on a foggy ridge line under stars at twilight.

caption: Stop letting banks quietly slice off $15 a month for junk fees. Opt out today. #money #personalfinance #creditcard #financialtips #quietmoney
